from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CitationLink(BaseModel):
    """A directed citation relationship extracted from a single document."""
    source_paper_title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper making the reference")
    target_paper_title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper being referenced")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Extraction results for a single document containing found citation links."""
    citation_links: list[CitationLink] = Field(description="List of reference relationships found in this document")
